**Overview of the Loan Agreement**

You are borrowing $10,000 from the bank at an interest rate of 8% per year. The loan is to be repaid over a period of 3 years, with monthly payments of $313.36 starting from November 8, 2025. You must make monthly payments of $313.36 on the 8th of every month until the loan is fully repaid.

**Key Terms that Apply to You**

* You can make lump sum payments at any time without penalty.
* If you miss a payment or make a late payment, you may be charged a late fee of $25.
* The loan amount is unsecured, which means you do not need to provide any collateral or security to the lender.

**EMI and Payment Details**

Based on the loan terms, your monthly payment (EMI) is $313.36. Over the 3-year period, you will pay a total of $40.61, which includes $4.61 in interest. This means you will pay the principal amount of $10,000 over 36 months, with a total interest of $4.61.

**In Summary**

This loan agreement requires you to make monthly payments of $313.36 for 3 years. You have the flexibility to make lump sum payments without penalty, but be aware of the late fee of $25 if you miss a payment. The total interest paid over the life of the loan is $4.61.
